FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'merci' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. Mrs, Madam
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. thank you

2. How do you say 'This is my father.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   B. C'est mon père.
   C. Voici ma grand-mère.
   D. C'est mon frère.

3. How do you say 'Put the book on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   B. C'est un lit.
   C. Mets le livre sur la table.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

4. What does 'la salle de bain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bathroom
   B. the window
   C. the fridge
   D. the house

5. How do you say 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le jeudi, je chante.
   B. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   C. Une semaine, sept jours.
   D. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

6. What does 'l'église' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the school
   B. the week
   C. the church
   D. the day

7. What number is 'dix-huit' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 18
   C. 31
   D. 8

8. What number is 'quatre' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 31
   D. 14

9. Fill in: J'ai ______ ans. (10) (1 mark)
   A. dix
   B. cinq
   C. douze
   D. six

10. How do you say 'I drink a juice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   B. C'est un gâteau.
   C. C'est bon pour la santé.
   D. Je bois un jus.

11. What does 'le lait' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cake
   B. cheese
   C. milk
   D. chips

12. What does 'le poisson' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. juice
   C. the banana
   D. the carrot

13. How do you say 'Touch your nose!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il est grand.
   B. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   C. Touche ton nez !
   D. J'ai une bouche.

14. What does 'la tête' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the head
   B. the neck
   C. the mouth
   D. the tooth

15. What does 'le cou' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the neck
   B. the hair
   C. the nose
   D. the leg

16. Fill in: Il ______ . (It is raining.) (1 mark)
   A. est pleut
   B. fait pleut
   C. y a pleut
   D. pleut

17. What does 'Il y a du vent.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. It is windy.
   C. It is freezing.
   D. It is hot.

18. What does 'Il gèle.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is hot.
   B. It is freezing.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. It is windy.

19. What does 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pleased to meet you!
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. My name is Njeri.
   D. What is your name?

20. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Kamau: Salut, Amina ! Ça va ? Amina: Oui, ça va bien, merci. Question: How does Amina answer? (1 mark)
   A. She gives her age.
   B. She says goodbye.
   C. She says she is well.
   D. She asks for a present.

21. Which little word goes with 'garçon' (the boy)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. le
   D. l'

22. What does 'Le livre est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. It is a bed.
   C. The cat is under the chair.
   D. Put the book on the table.

23. Fill in: Le chat est ______ le lit et la porte. (between) (1 mark)
   A. sur
   B. dans
   C. sous
   D. entre

24. What does 'Le jeudi, je chante.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, I rest.
   B. Today it is Monday.
   C. On Thursday, I sing.
   D. On Friday, I dance.

25. What does 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Thursday, I sing.
   B. Today it is Monday.
   C. On Sunday, I rest.
   D. What day is it today?

26. What does 'Ce sont des mangues.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning, I eat bread.
   B. I like milk.
   C. They are mangoes.
   D. At midday, I eat rice and beans.

27. What does 'Ce sont des oranges.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. They are oranges.
   B. I do not like fish.
   C. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   D. What is it?

28. Which little word goes with 'main' (the hand)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

29. Fill in: Elle est ______. (short) (1 mark)
   A. petite
   B. longs
   C. noirs
   D. petit

30. What does 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Go straight ahead.
   B. Turn right.
   C. Where is the key?
   D. Excuse me, where is the school?

31. How do you say 'And you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   B. Je m'appelle Amina.
   C. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   D. Et toi ?

32. How do you say 'the chair' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le canapé
   B. la douche
   C. le chat
   D. la chaise

33. Fill in: C'est ______ table. (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. des
   C. un
   D. une

34. How do you say 'the church' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la semaine
   B. le jour
   C. l'école
   D. l'église

35. How do you say 'Tuesday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mercredi
   B. mardi
   C. lundi
   D. samedi

36. How do you write the number 2 in French? (1 mark)
   A. vingt-cinq
   B. deux
   C. neuf
   D. onze

37. How do you write the number 4 in French? (1 mark)
   A. deux
   B. vingt
   C. douze
   D. quatre

38. How do you say 'a cake' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un anniversaire
   B. un mois
   C. un gâteau
   D. un ballon

39. How do you say 'the storm' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le vent
   B. le soleil
   C. la pluie
   D. l'orage

40. How do you say 'near' in French? (1 mark)
   A. tout droit
   B. à droite
   C. à gauche
   D. près de

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write a short birthday dialogue of four lines. (4 marks) (4 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'I am ten years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Il a les cheveux courts.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Le vendredi, je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'I do not like fish.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 12 May.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'Where is the key?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'J'aime le lait.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux oreilles.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: 'J'ai un nez.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'This is my father.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'Le jeudi, je chante.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Give three tips for listening for the gist of a message. (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'There is a cake and there are balloons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

56. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Je bois un jus.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'Voici ma famille.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'They are mangoes.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'This is my sister.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into English: 'Demain, c'est jeudi.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — thank you
   merci means thank you.

2. B — C'est mon père.
   This is my father. in French is C'est mon père.

3. C — Mets le livre sur la table.
   Put the book on the table. in French is Mets le livre sur la table.

4. A — the bathroom
   la salle de bain means the bathroom.

5. B — Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   On Saturday, I help my mother. in French is Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.

6. C — the church
   l'église means the church.

7. B — 18
   dix-huit means 18.

8. A — 4
   quatre means 4.

9. A — dix
   Dix means ten.

10. D — Je bois un jus.
   I drink a juice. in French is Je bois un jus.

11. C — milk
   le lait means milk.

12. A — fish
   le poisson means fish.

13. C — Touche ton nez !
   Touch your nose! in French is Touche ton nez !

14. A — the head
   la tête means the head.

15. A — the neck
   le cou means the neck.

16. D — pleut
   We say Il pleut, without fait.

17. B — It is windy.
   Il y a du vent. means It is windy..

18. B — It is freezing.
   Il gèle. means It is freezing..

19. C — My name is Njeri.
   Je m'appelle Njeri. means My name is Njeri.

20. C — She says she is well.
   Ça va bien, merci means I am well, thank you.

21. C — le
   garçon is masculine, so we say le garçon.

22. A — The book is on the table.
   Le livre est sur la table. means The book is on the table.

23. D — entre
   Entre means between.

24. C — On Thursday, I sing.
   Le jeudi, je chante. means On Thursday, I sing.

25. D — What day is it today?
   Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ? means What day is it today?

26. C — They are mangoes.
   Ce sont des mangues. means They are mangoes.

27. A — They are oranges.
   Ce sont des oranges. means They are oranges.

28. D — la
   main is feminine, so we say la main.

29. A — petite
   For a girl, we add e: petite.

30. D — Excuse me, where is the school?
   Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? means Excuse me, where is the school?

31. D — Et toi ?
   And you? in French is Et toi ?.

32. D — la chaise
   the chair in French is la chaise.

33. D — une
   Table is feminine, so une.

34. D — l'église
   the church in French is l'église.

35. B — mardi
   Tuesday in French is mardi.

36. B — deux
   2 in French is deux.

37. D — quatre
   4 in French is quatre.

38. C — un gâteau
   a cake in French is un gâteau.

39. D — l'orage
   the storm in French is l'orage.

40. D — près de
   near in French is près de.
